prompts.title: Recent Form Across Available Samples
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical. Charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 typography, lime #c5ed74 accent, slate #8ca6bf secondary. The lower quarter is reserved for permanent yellow subtitles; every element resolves above it.

EDITORIAL — kinetic typography and rhythmic emphasis. Open on the warm-white word FORMA snapping in at half width with a single lime underline flick. Three rhythmic beats follow in narration time: lime VICTORIA, slate EMPATE, outlined DERROTA, each stamping with a one-frame shake and a soft grain puff. Coventry City FC and Newcastle United FC enter as Spanish team plates sliding from opposite edges behind crest-shaped masks; on each beat the stronger plate pushes forward and the other recoils a step. A slow scanline sweep crosses the frame before the exit. No axes, no counts, no invented match events. Exit: both plates compact into a vertical lime seam that becomes the transition into the statistical variant.

STATISTICAL — grouped count bars. Heading FORMA RECIENTE, subheading Últimos partidos. Two horizontal grouped bars, one per Spanish team label (Coventry City FC, Newcastle United FC), each split into Victorias {{home.wins}} / {{away.wins}}, Empates {{home.draws}} / {{away.draws}}, Derrotas {{home.losses}} / {{away.losses}}, on a shared zero baseline and one common scale in partidos. Axis label partidos sits in slate at the baseline, with unit stated once. Entry animation: baseline draws left to right, then segments grow in narration order while value tags count up at each bar end in warm white. Sample annotation below the chart reads muestra {{home.n}} partidos · fuente Bzzoiro and muestra {{away.n}} partidos · fuente Bzzoiro on separate rows, so unequal samples remain visually obvious wherever the two facts differ; a small slate badge notes that samples vary across the catalog. Main comparison: the Coventry City FC derrotas segment expands and flashes lime while remaining segments dim toward slate. Camera: slow push-in toward the decisive segment, one focal point, no panning away. Exit: bars collapse into a horizontal line, and that line performs the transition to the following scene.

prompts.title: Goals For and Against, Both Teams
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, GoatLab charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents. Lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles; all composition stays above it.

EDITORIAL — illustrative football pitch and ball path. A stylised pitch drawn in slate lines fills the upper three quarters in soft perspective, goal frame at the top. Two abstract trails travel across the turf: a lime trail arcing forward, a slate trail curving back, both rendered as pure motion graphics with no scoreline, no shirts and no invented match events. Spanish captions GOLES A FAVOR and GOLES EN CONTRA float on the grass beside each trail, and the two team names appear as thin warm-white labels anchored to opposite corners. The lime trail accelerates on the narration's stressed word while the slate trail drags and thickens. Camera drifts slowly along the halfway line. Exit: the pitch lines retract into a single vertical seam, and that seam is the transition into the statistical variant.

STATISTICAL — paired bars for both teams on a shared scale. Heading GOLES, subheading Últimos partidos. Four horizontal bars in two pairs: Coventry City FC a favor {{home.gf}} and en contra {{home.ga}}; Newcastle United FC a favor {{away.gf}} and en contra {{away.ga}}. One common scale in goles, shared zero baseline, equal bar thickness, Spanish category labels Goles a favor and Goles recibidos repeated per pair, axis label goles printed once in slate with the unit. Entry animation: the axis draws, then pairs grow left to right as the narration names each side, value tags settling in warm white at the ends. Sample annotation under the chart: muestra {{home.n}} partidos · fuente Bzzoiro and muestra {{away.n}} partidos · fuente Bzzoiro, source credited in slate, football context line in warm white. Main comparison: the Newcastle United FC a favor bar rises and glows lime while the Coventry City FC en contra bar glows slate, making the contrast readable at a glance. Emphasis stays on one focal pair; the rest dims to a low-opacity warm white. Camera: gentle push-in, no rotation. Exit: bars flatten into a baseline that performs the transition out.

prompts.title: Clean Sheets by Count
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74, slate #8ca6bf. Lower quarter held for permanent yellow subtitles.

EDITORIAL — defensive energy and a stylised shield. A large outlined shield in slate is constructed line by line in the centre of the frame, its face divided by thin vertical ribs. Warm-white Spanish captions VALLAS INVENCIBLES and ARCOS EN CERO appear as the shield locks together, each rib lighting lime in sequence with the narration's pulse. Defensive energy is expressed as slow compression: the shield narrows, holds, and springs back once, throwing a thin lime ring across the frame. Team names Coventry City FC and Newcastle United FC sit on either side as Spanish plates without crests, and each plate pulses in turn as its defence is named. No axes, no counts, no invented match events, no save animations implying real incidents. Exit: the shield folds to a vertical seam that carries the transition into the statistical variant.

STATISTICAL — counts only, no conversion into rates. Heading ARCOS EN CERO, subheading Últimos partidos. Two vertical columns of discrete unit marks, one column per Spanish team label, each mark a small rounded tile in lime, with the count tag {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}} resting above each column in warm white. Axis label arcos en cero, unit partidos, shared zero baseline and one common scale so column heights are directly comparable. The chart is explicitly counts, so no fraction, rate or proportional rescaling is applied at any moment. Entry animation: baseline and axis labels draw first, tiles drop in one at a time in narration order, values counting up. Sample annotation beneath: muestra {{home.n}} partidos · fuente Bzzoiro and muestra {{away.n}} partidos · fuente Bzzoiro, with the source line in slate; if the two sample facts differ, a slate divider flags the unequal samples rather than normalising them. Main comparison: the taller column brightens lime while the other recedes to slate, single focal point. Camera: slow vertical tilt following the taller column, then settling. Exit: tiles slide together into a line, and the line performs the transition out.

prompts.title: Head-to-Head History
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74, slate #8ca6bf. The lower quarter stays clear for permanent yellow subtitles.

EDITORIAL — both teams as a visual duel. The frame splits on a vertical hairline: Coventry City FC on the left plate in slate, Newcastle United FC on the right plate in lime, both lettered in Spanish and pushed toward each other as the narration begins. The hairline vibrates, then snaps: impacts radiate as concentric rings, one ring per clash the narration implies, without any invented results, scorers or scorelines. Spanish heading CRUCES PREVIOS lands across the split in warm white with a lime underline that travels between the two halves. Energy escalates through quick counter-motion of the two plates, ending in a hard hold. Exit: the hairline widens into a full-height seam, which is the transition into the statistical variant.

STATISTICAL — historical counts with total sample. Heading HISTORIAL DE CRUCES, subheading lectura histórica, no pronóstico. One hundred (in layout terms, full width) horizontal stacked bar representing {{h2h.total}} partidos in cruces, divided into three Spanish segments: victorias de Coventry City FC {{h2h.homeWins}}, empates {{h2h.draws}}, victorias de Newcastle United FC {{h2h.awayWins}}. Shared zero baseline, one common scale in partidos, segment value tags in warm white, axis label cruces históricos. A Spanish caption reads Este historial no es un pronóstico. Entry animation: the bar wipes from left to right, each segment locking with a short lime tick while the narration names it; the total tag {{h2h.total}} stamps above the bar last. Sample annotation under the chart: muestra {{h2h.total}} cruces · fuente Bzzoiro, source line in slate, with a note that the sample covers only recorded meetings. Main comparison: the Newcastle United FC segment pulses lime, the Coventry City FC segment cools to slate, the draw segment stays neutral warm white. Camera: lateral slide along the bar, stopping on the largest segment. Exit: segments compress inward, and the compression performs the transition out.

prompts.title: Form Versus History
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, charcoal #101412 ground, warm white #edf0e6 type, lime #c5ed74 and slate #8ca6bf accents. Lower quarter reserved for permanent yellow subtitles throughout.

EDITORIAL — team reveals and narrative emphasis. Begin on darkness with a single warm-white Spanish word FORMA, then reveal Coventry City FC: a slate plate rises, rotates flat and holds while the word DERROTAS breathes beside it. The plate recedes and Newcastle United FC reveals the same way in lime, its plate steadier, brighter, occupying more of the frame. The word HISTORIA then rises between the two plates as a third element, weightier than either, carrying the narrative pivot. No scores, no invented events, no predictions; motion carries the emphasis. Camera holds a slow push toward the centre so the eye lands on the word HISTORIA. Exit: the three elements fold into one vertical seam, which is the transition into the statistical variant.

STATISTICAL — two grounded readings, one tension, published estimates absent. Left panel heading FORMA RECIENTE with Spanish labels victorias {{home.wins}} and derrotas {{home.losses}} as two short horizontal bars on a shared zero baseline in partidos; right panel heading HISTORIAL DE CRUCES with segments victorias de Coventry City FC {{h2h.homeWins}} and victorias de Newcastle United FC {{h2h.awayWins}} drawn on one common scale in partidos, plus the total tag {{h2h.total}}. Unit partidos appears once per panel; both baselines start at zero and both scales are labelled. A slate band between the panels carries the Spanish caption fuente Bzzoiro · muestra declarada por cada hecho, marking that the two panels come from different samples and that the catalog contains no published model estimates, so nothing here is an estimate and nothing is predictive. Entry animation: both panels draw in parallel, bars locking left to right, then the slate band sweeps between them. Main comparison: the historical panel's Newcastle United FC segment pulses lime while the form panel's derrotas bar holds slate, forming the single tension the narration supports. Focal point stays on the panel junction. Camera tilts slightly from the total tag down to the bars. Exit: both panels fold to a vertical line, and that line performs the transition out.
